name: Chichi Fetish 2 Tsundere I-Cup Race Queen Risa ~Paizuri Hen~
original_name: 乳フェチ2 ツンデレIcup レースクイーン理沙～パイズリ編～
source:
Risa is from a rich family. However, his parents suddenly declare bankruptcy and she can't pay the rent of her apartment. She starts working as a race queen and meets Ukyo, a racer. Ukyo hears her trouble and pays the rent for her. To repay it, Risa gives him Paizuri.... Like this, she gradually falls in love with Ukyo....

[Edited from ErogeShop.com]
translation:
理沙出身富裕家庭。然而，她的父母突然宣布破产，她也无力支付公寓房租。为此，她开始担任赛车女郎，并认识了赛车手右京。右京听说她的困境后，替她付了房租。为了报答他，理沙用乳交为他服务…就这样，她渐渐爱上了右京…
